title: Can Activation Steering Substitute for Prompt-Based Affective Priming in LLM Digital Twins?
abstract: arXiv:2611.22738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Affective priming -- asking participants to write about a recalled event, such as a time they felt grateful or lacked control, and then measuring the induced state and its spillover onto related judgments -- is a standard way to manipulate emotion in the social sciences, and it also shifts the responses of LLM-based digital twins. The writing task, however, requires generating a full text. We test whether activation steering can replace it. Using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 100 personas in two domains (gratitude, lack of control), we compare a real-prompt path replicating the original Twin-2K-500 Mega Study (J2) with an injection path that skips the writing and adds a mean-difference direction, extracted from human writing, to the residual stream at varying strengths. translated_title: 激活引导能否替代大语言模型数字孪生中基于提示的情感启动？
translated_abstract: 情感启动——要求参与者撰写关于回忆事件的文章，例如他们感到感激或缺乏控制感的时刻，然后测量所诱发的状态及其对相关判断的溢出效应——是社会科学中操纵情绪的标准方法，它同样会改变基于大语言模型的数字孪生的响应。然而，这种写作任务需要生成完整的文本。我们测试激活引导是否能替代它。我们使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在两个领域（感激、缺乏控制感）中对100个人格进行实验，将复制原始Twin-2K-500大型研究（J2）的真实提示路径与一种注入路径进行比较，后者跳过写作步骤，在不同强度下将从人类写作文本中提取的均值差异方向注入残差流。在6个比较中有5个，真实提示效应落在原始人类效应与数字孪生效应之间。注入以剂量依赖的方式改变操纵检验，并且……
tldr: 本研究测试了激活引导技术能否替代传统的提示式情感启动方法来操纵LLM数字孪生的情绪状态，发现注入方法能以剂量依赖的方式改变模型响应，但真实提示路径在多数比较中效应介于原始人类与数字孪生效应之间。
en_tdlr: This study tests whether activation steering can substitute for prompt-based affective priming in LLM digital twins, finding that injection shifts manipulation checks in a dose-dependent manner, while real-prompt effects fall between the original human and digital-twin effects in 5 of 6 comparisons.
